articles.summary: WASHINGTON, D.C. and CHARLESTON, WV--United Bankshares, Inc. (the “Company” or “United”) announced that at its August 24, 2026 board meeting, the Board of Directors declared a third quarter dividend of $0.38 per share for shareholders of record as of September 11, 2026. The year of 2025 represented the 52nd consecutive year of dividend increases for United shareholders. Only one other major banking company in the USA has achieved such a dividend record.
articles.title: United Bankshares Declares Third Quarter Dividend and Announces New Stock Repurchase Program
